title: AAEF welcome a new Trustee/Director Mr Kerry Rubie
body:
AAEF welcome a new Trustee/Director Mr Kerry Rubie who brings a wealth of experience in advertising and marketing. He has spent several years in Hong Kong and has a great interest in Education, the Arts and Ballet.

Kerry is an Australian born, noted rugby player and rower. Kerry was former Chairman of Leo Burnett Worldwide Inc an American Advertising and marketing company with operations in 87 countries, employing over 6000 with billings in excess of 900 million including famed clients such as Coca Cola, McDonalds, Heinz, Kellogg's, Kraft, Phillip Morris, Proctor & Gamble and Visa International.

Kerry has a wealth of experience in creative advertising, product promotion and the media including radio, television and films.

Kerry has a keen interest in ballet and has given his services to several institutions and charities including acting as Chairman of the Royal Academy of Dance and Chairman of Friends of the Elderly.


More details to be found in our Trustee / Directors page.
